notes: Variants table for tiktok/batch_02. Edit freely — each `raw` filename must match a real .mp4 inside tiktok/batch_02/raw/. Audio modes: passthrough (default — keeps native game SFX from the recording), synth (build SFX bed from cadence + mistakes when raw was recorded silent), silent (-an).

variants.name: tiktok02_01_60_seconds.mp4
variants.intent: Real touchscreen solve. Hook lands as the player taps the first card. Goal: surface the 60-second daily-ritual promise without face cam.

variants.name: tiktok02_02_watch_the_tabs.mp4
variants.intent: Foldwink Tabs reveal-on-correct mechanic showcased. Each correct solve adds a letter to the unsolved tabs. Unique visual, no other Connections clone has it.

variants.name: tiktok02_03_one_free_hint.mp4
variants.intent: Wink mechanic showcase — tap a tab to reveal its full category once per puzzle. Sells the one decision the name earns.

variants.name: tiktok02_04_two_left.mp4
variants.ctaText: Comment if you’d have picked wrong.
variants.intent: Near-fail recovery arc. Tension → save. Mirrors batch_01 best performer (post-08) but with native touch.

variants.name: tiktok02_05_hard_mode.mp4
variants.intent: Master Challenge flex — filters for the enthusiast subset most likely to actually install. Hard mode unlock implies depth.
